title: ZymoBIOMICS DNA/RNA Miniprep Kit Protocol for Marine Invertebrate Tissues
author: Alex Veglia
materials: Proceed to DNA and RNA Purification after incubation.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Workspace
steps.instruction: Prepare tubes and heating equipment in a sterile environment.

substeps.instruction: UV 3 sets of 1.5 ml tubes (42 tubes total, 3x14) in the dead air box, ensuring the inside of tube lids are not touched.
UV 2 sets of 1.5 ml LoBind tubes in the dead air box.
Set heat block to 50°C or incubator to 37°C.

steps.title: Initial Sample Processing
steps.instruction: Centrifuge thawed samples and separate supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge thawed samples at 8,000 xG for 30 seconds (ensure centrifuge is set to xg, not rcf).
Remove 400 µL of supernatant and place into a pre-labeled, pre-UV'ed 1.5 ml tube.
Store tubes containing remaining tissue in a -80°C freezer.

steps.title: Proteinase K Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the sample using Proteinase K and specific buffers.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µL of Proteinase K Digestion Buffer to the sample. (To prepare 1 mL buffer: mix 20 µL 5M NaCl, 10 µL 1M Tris pH 9.0, 2 µL 0.5M EDTA, 50 µL 10% SDS, and 918 µL RNA/DNAse Free Water).
Add 20 µL of Proteinase K.
Incubate for 2.5 hours at 50°C.

steps.title: Sample Lysis and Filtration
steps.instruction: Lyse the sample and filter using a Spin-Away Filter.

substeps.instruction: Add 460 µL DNA/RNA Lysis Buffer and vortex for 2-3 seconds or mix well.
Transfer 460 µL of the sample into a yellow Spin-Away Filter in a 2 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 16,000 xG for 1 minute and save the flow-through in a 2 mL tube.
Transfer the yellow Spin-Away Filter into a new Collection Tube.
Transfer the remaining 460 µL of sample into the same yellow Spin-Away Filter, ensuring it is placed on the 2 mL centrifuge tube containing the previous flow-through.
Centrifuge at 16,000 xG for 1 minute and save the flow-through in a 2 mL tube.
Transfer the yellow Spin-Away Filter into a new Collection Tube.

steps.title: RNA Purification and Binding
steps.instruction: Bind RNA to the Zymo-Spin IILCG Column.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume (e.g., 920 µL) of 95-100% ethanol to the flow-through in a 2 mL tube (1:1 ratio) and mix well.
Transfer the sample into a green Zymo-Spin IILCG Column in a Collection Tube.
Centrifuge at 16,000 xG for 1 minute and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: RNA Washing and DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Wash the column and perform on-column DNase digestion.

substeps.instruction: Add 420 µL DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the green column, centrifuge at 16,000 xG for 2 minutes, and discard the flow-through.
Prepare DNase I Reaction Mix (5 µL DNase I and 75 µL DNA Digestion Buffer) in a nuclease-free tube and mix by gentle inversion.
Add 80 µL of the DNase I Reaction Mix directly into the column matrix and incubate at room temperature (20-30°C) for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Final Column Washing
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to purify the nucleic acids.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL DNA/RNA Prep Buffer to the columns, centrifuge at 16,000 xG for 1 minute, and discard the flow-through.
Add 700 µL of DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the columns (pipetting down the sides of the tube), centrifuge at 16,000 xg for 1 minute, and discard flow-through.
Add 250 µL DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge at 16,000 xg for 1 minute, and discard flow-through.
Add 250 µL DNA/RNA Wash Buffer to the column, centrifuge at 16,000 xg for 3 minutes, discard flow-through, and transfer columns to new collection tubes.

steps.title: Elution and HRC Filter Preparation
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA/RNA and prepare the HRC Spin Filters.

substeps.instruction: Add 50-100 µL DNase/RNase-Free Water to the column and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature (or on ice for RNA).
While incubating, prepare Zymo-Spin III HRC Spin Filters: place filter in a Collection Tube, add 600 µL ZymoBIOMICS HRC Prep Solution, and centrifuge at 8,000 xG for 3 minutes.
Centrifuge the columns containing DNase/RNase-Free water at 16,000 xg for 2 minutes and discard the column.

steps.title: Final Purification and Storage
steps.instruction: Perform final filtration, quantification, and storage.

substeps.instruction: Transfer prepared Zymo-Spin III-HRC Spin Filters into labeled 1.5 mL LoBind tubes.
Transfer eluted DNA/RNA into a Zymo-Spin IV-HRC Spin Filter.
Centrifuge at 16,000 xg for 3 minutes.
Quantify all samples using a Nanodrop (keep samples on ice, blank with DNase/RNase-Free Water, and record results).
Optional for RNA: Add 2.5 µL of RiboLOCK to RNA samples.
Store DNA and RNA samples in a -80°C freezer in the appropriate box.
